content: Table TABREF35 shows the event extraction results on the three datasets. The statistics are obtained with the default parameter setting that INLINEFORM0 is set to 5, number of hidden units INLINEFORM1 is set to 200, and INLINEFORM2 contains three fully-connected layers. The event number INLINEFORM3 for three datasets are set to 25, 25 and 35, respectively. The examples of extracted events are shown in Table. TABREF36 .
